description: The Telangana govt. is launching India’s first state-led AI data exchange, TGDeX, providing access to datasets and AI models.
body_lead: The Telangana Government, in partnership with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), is going to launch the Telangana Data Exchange (TGDeX) – which is essentially an artificial intelligence (AI)-focused digital public infrastructure (DPI) – on July 2, according to a Hindu report. TGDeX – which is India’s first-ever state-led DPI for AI – aims to develop cross-domain AI solutions between the State, research institutions, industry, and startups.
